name: Solo Weekend at the Quiet Room, Kings Mill
summary: One guest, one room over a converted mill, a set daily order of sits, walks, and reading, silent until 4pm. No teacher. First-timers welcome. £95.
description:
The Quiet Room is a single bedsit above a former woollen mill, let to one person at a time for a weekend of quiet.

**A set day**
We give you a card. 7.00 sit (20 minutes; a timer is provided). 7.30 breakfast, left outside the door. 8.30 to 11.00 walk (three routes marked on the map, 3 to 6 miles). 11.30 sit. 12.30 lunch. 13.30 to 16.00 reading or rest; the room has a shelf of contemplative writing from several traditions. 16.00 tea, and silence ends. 17.00 sit. 18.30 supper. 20.00 sit. Bed.

**Silence**
Kept until 4pm each day. After that you may come down to the mill kitchen, where one of us is usually about, or stay up.

**Guidance**
None. The card is the guidance. We are not teachers and there is no tradition here; the bookshelf is deliberately mixed.

**For whom**
People who have never done this and want to try it without a group or a teacher watching. The set order takes the deciding out of it. Also people who have done a lot of this and want a plain weekend.

**Physical**
The walks are real hills, moderate rather than hard. All optional but on the card.
practical: Friday 6pm to Sunday 2pm, most weekends. £95 including all meals. One guest. Room with bed, desk, chair, kettle, shared bathroom downstairs. Bring boots and waterproofs. Nearest station Machynlleth, 8 miles; we collect. Mobile signal patchy; wifi in the mill.
